observations: The required assembly_topology checker reports 25 PASS items and one FAIL; therefore engineering approval is not permitted.
The only measured failure is undeclared interference between slanted_back_panel and top_shelf: 842681.309 mm³ against an allowed maximum of 6251.241 mm³.

The measured intersection occupies the full shelf width in X and the rear strip Y=180.367..205.0 mm through the complete top-shelf thickness Z=1632..1668 mm. This is consistent with the top shelf extending to Y=205 while the inclined back panel crosses that rear shelf region.

Current source inspection confirms Shelf.__init__ creates every shelf at 410 mm depth centered at Y=0, while SlantedBackPanel.__init__ creates a 24 x 260 mm panel inclined -7 degrees about +X. The back-panel connection places its local origin at assembly Y=197, Z=1669.

All six print parts, all five generated TabSlot interfaces, every individual part-connectivity check, and every other undeclared-interference pair passed. These are preservation constraints for the repair.

The existing back-panel angle is real, but the visual review found it insufficiently legible. A very small increase in the same rotation can be coordinated with the topology repair; no second rotation is warranted.
The shelf-side and back-panel interface dimensions, including fit_offset_mm=0.2, are not implicated and must remain frozen.
required_changes: Create rear clearance between the three aligned shelves and the slanted back panel by minimally reducing the common shelf depth and moving the common shelf body slightly toward -Y. Keep all three shelves identical and aligned.

Within the same patch, increase only the existing back-panel inclination slightly and update tilted_vertical, the back-panel slot-frame origin, and its inverse print orientation consistently. Do not add another rotation or alter any TabSlot parameter.

Re-export and rerun assembly_topology. Confirm that the slanted_back_panel/top_shelf overlap is removed without disturbing the five currently passing interfaces, other passing part pairs, six-part grouping, or frozen 1125 x 450 x 1800 mm envelope.
checker_interpretation: UNDECLARED_PART_INTERFERENCE is measured overlapping material, not an interface declaration or solver error. Because slanted_back_panel and top_shelf have no declared mutual connection, their 842681.309 mm³ intersection must be removed geometrically.

The failed AABB ends at the top shelf's current rear edge Y=205 and exactly matches its Z thickness of 36 mm. Moving the shared shelf rear edge forward of the back panel's minimum Y over Z=1632..1668 directly targets the measured region.

A bounded shelf change from 410 mm depth at Y=0 to approximately 400 mm depth at Y=-24.5 gives an approximate shelf range Y=-224.5..175.5. This stays inside the frozen ±225 mm depth envelope and provides clearance from the reported Y minimum of 180.367 mm.

If the existing back-panel rotation is changed from -7 to approximately -8 degrees, its placement and interface direction must be recomputed together. Keeping its rear and upper extrema within Y=225 and Z=1800 gives an approximate center Y=195.0, Z=1669.6; the corresponding slot origin in right_side_panel local coordinates is approximately Y=195.0, Z=769.6.

The proposed values are hypotheses derived from the current primitive dimensions and reported intersection bounds. They do not establish a pass until the source is re-exported and assembly_topology is rerun.

repair_proposals.hypothesis: If all three Shelf bodies retain equal dimensions but their common depth is reduced slightly and shifted toward -Y so their rear edge is no farther back than about Y=176, the top shelf will no longer intersect the inclined back panel over Z=1632..1668. Coordinating a one-degree increase of the existing back-panel inclination with its direction vector and slot-frame origin should improve the required visible slant while retaining the frozen envelope and the passing back-panel interface.
evidence: Measured overlap is 842681.309 mm³, exceeding the 6251.241 mm³ threshold.
Shelf.__init__ currently uses Cube((1045.0, 410.0, 36.0), center=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)); after placement, top_shelf therefore reaches Y=205 and Z=1632..1668.
SlantedBackPanel.__init__ currently rotates a 1045 x 24 x 260 mm panel by -7 degrees about +X.
connect_back_panel_to_right_side currently uses tilted_vertical=(0.0, 0.1218693434, 0.9925461516) and a slot-frame origin based on assembly Y=197, Z=1669.
All five INTERFACE_GEOMETRY_PAIRED checks and all other part-pair interference checks currently pass.

tilted_vertical.rule: Use (0, sin(abs(angle)), cos(abs(angle))) for the selected negative +X rotation; approximately (0, 0.139173, 0.990268) at -8 degrees.

print_orientation_x_deg.rule: Update from +7 degrees to the inverse of the selected assembly body rotation, approximately +8 degrees.

expected_improvements: Remove the measured top_shelf/slanted_back_panel overlap by placing the common shelf rear edge ahead of the back panel throughout the top-shelf Z band.
Retain three equally sized, aligned, usable shelves with only a small depth reduction from the nominal 410 mm.
Make the existing upper-back-panel inclination somewhat more readable without introducing a second transform.
Keep the final depth and height extrema controlled by the unchanged full-height side panels and the bounded back-panel placement.
possible_regressions: Changing Shelf.__init__ affects lower_shelf, middle_shelf, and top_shelf; all shelf-to-side interfaces must be checked even though the edit is common and bounded.
Moving shelf bodies relative to connector origins could reduce local material around tabs if taken outside the proposed bounds.
Incorrectly updating tilted_vertical or the back-panel slot-frame origin could break connect_back_panel_to_right_side mate alignment.
Increasing the panel angle without recomputing its origin could exceed Y=225 or Z=1800, or recreate interference near the shelf rear edge.
The smaller shelf depth may alter the rendered side profile, though the proposed 398..402 mm range remains close to the requested approximately 410 mm depth.
preserve: Exactly six separate print parts and five existing physical interfaces.
All assembly.connect calls and their receiver-first acyclic ordering.
Both full-height 40 x 450 x 1800 mm side panels and their floor contact.
Three horizontal shelves with matching dimensions, aligned front and rear edges, centers at Z=450, 1050, and 1650 mm, and unobstructed upper surfaces.
The top_shelf semantic identity and its upward surface in the frozen load-selection band, although FEA is not evaluated in this run.
The single intrinsic back-panel rotation and the visibly slanted upper-rear-panel requirement.
The exact 1125 x 450 x 1800 mm assembled envelope and mm_per_unit=1.
All currently passing interface and non-interference results.
preconditions: Derive tilted_vertical and the back-panel slot-frame origin from the same selected angle and placement; do not edit them independently.
Verify analytically before export that every shelf remains within Y=-225..225 and the back panel remains within Y=-225..225 and Z=0..1800.
Do not change checker settings, tolerances, part declarations, connection count, fit allowance, or connector parameters.
